edges.label: NIDS scientist before the federal contract
edges.note: Davis carried the NIDS methodology forward into BAASS work under the DIA-funded AAWSAP contract after 2008.

edges.label: author of the notes at the centre of the custody claim
edges.note: The memo records Vice Adm. Thomas Wilson being refused access to a program holding a recovered craft on the ground that it sat with a private aerospace contractor and he had no need to know. Davis has never authenticated it; Wilson has denied the meeting.

edges.label: Puthoff was among the consultants Bigelow hired at NIDS in 1995
edges.note: The New Yorker records that among the consultants Bigelow hired was Hal Puthoff, 'whose work in paranormal studies dated back decades, to Project Stargate.'

edges.label: Vallee served on the NIDS advisory board
edges.note: Vallee had been at SRI in the 1970s and had documented deliberate human disinformation in UFO cases from 1979 - the phenomenon later confirmed in the Bennewitz affair.

edges.label: Alexander sat on the NIDS board from its founding
edges.note: Alexander brought Los Alamos and Army INSCOM programme experience and had previously convened a cleared interagency canvass for a compartmented UFO effort.

b.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)

edges.label: The private field programme was re-federalised as a DIA contract without changing personnel
edges.note: This is the structural pivot of the era: capability was privatised in 1995 and re-acquired by contract in 2008, meaning the government never had to stand up an acknowledged office.

b.label: Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies (BAASS), LLC

edges.label: NIDS personnel and methods carried directly into the DIA-funded BAASS contract
edges.note: NIDS closed in 2004; in 2007 a senior DIA official wrote to Bigelow about Skinwalker Ranch, and BAASS won the AAWSAP contract the following year with substantially the same people.

edges.label: founded and privately funded NIDS 1995-2004
edges.note: NIDS described itself as a privately funded science institute studying aerial phenomena and animal mutilations; Bigelow shut it down in 2004.

edges.label: DIA sponsored the remote-viewing effort 1986-1995
edges.note: DIA's prior experience running an unacknowledged programme in a ridiculed domain is the institutional precedent for its 2008 AAWSAP contract.
